verdict.rationale: Manufact documents API keys specifically for programmatic access from the REST API, CI pipelines, and scripts. It also ships an official CLI that deploys and manages servers, deployments, and env vars from the terminal, and supports git-push-triggered deployments with automatic publish checklists after each deploy. That covers the core of headless/CI automation, though only through first-party claims. Missing for 10: a documented CI recipe or GitHub Action, non-interactive CLI auth details, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
